passages.title: A: The Riverside Park
passages.text: This park offers beautiful walking paths along the river and large open fields for picnics. There is a small café serving local snacks and a boat hire service if you want to explore the water.

passages.title: B: Mountain Adventure Centre
passages.text: Perfect for those who love high-energy activities. You can try rock climbing, zip-lining, or mountain biking on our specially designed tracks. Equipment is provided for all visitors.

passages.title: C: Historical Castle Tour
passages.text: Step back in time with a guided tour of this 15th-century castle. You will learn about the royal history and see an impressive collection of ancient armor and paintings.

passages.title: D: City Art Gallery
passages.text: A quiet place to spend an afternoon. The gallery displays modern art from local artists and hosts weekly workshops where you can learn to paint or sculpt yourself.

passages.title: E: Coastal Wildlife Reserve
passages.text: Ideal for nature lovers. Walk along the beach to spot rare birds and seals. There is an information centre with experts who can tell you about the local marine life.

passages.title: F: Science Discovery Museum
passages.text: An interactive museum where you can touch everything! Great for families, the exhibits explain how electricity and space travel work through fun games and experiments.

passages.title: G: Old Town Market
passages.text: Visit our vibrant market to find unique handmade crafts, vintage clothing, and delicious street food from around the world. It is open every Saturday and Sunday.

passages.title: H: Botanical Gardens
passages.text: A peaceful escape featuring thousands of different plants and flowers from all over the globe. There are guided tours available to explain the rare species in the glasshouses.
